description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small stack of colorful folded cloths, with a pillow at the back. The left hand lifts the top light-blue cloth off the stack and, with the right hand helping, unfolds and spreads it flat on the bed; then the hands unstack the yellow and pink cloths, unfold them, and lay them one by one on top, smoothing the edges before placing another light-blue cloth and finally unfolding and stacking the green cloth on top.
